title: How This Rifle Fired Around Corners

scenes.headline: AROUND CORNERS
scenes.text: This rifle could shoot around corners.
And every bullet was slowly destroying it.
Germany, nineteen forty-five. Soviet troops advance west through streets and ruins.
German tank crews have a problem. Enemy soldiers get too close for the tank's guns.
So engineers add a curved extension. The Krummlauf. Thirty degrees for infantry. Ninety for tanks.
A mirror sight lets the soldier aim without showing his head.
But a bullet doesn't want to turn. It scrapes the curve on every shot.
The thirty-degree attachment lasted roughly three hundred rounds.
Only limited numbers were made before the war ended.
Would you trust a gun that shoots around corners?
